Shreyas Iyer addresses team selection after series loss

Indian cricket captain Shreyas Iyer has spoken about the decision to drop player Vaibhav Suryavanshi during a recent series. Iyer explained the reasoning behind the selection, stating he was the only one who felt a certain way about the situation. The team lost the series 4-0, prompting discussions about the team's performance and choices.
